source: openpsychometrics.org IPIP-FFM dataset (2018, public domain), 100,000-row sample, one record per IP address; all ages, because the file does not record age; 70/30 random split, seed 20261114

age_note.text: The 2018 file has no age column, so these norms include under-18s. In the 2012 file, where age is known, leaving the under-18s in moves each mean by the amount below (in SDs).

adults_2012.source: BIG5 (2012), adults 18+, training split: the norms used before the move to the 2018 file
